purpose: Candidate-neutral in-context demonstrations for pairwise evidence synthesis. Synthetic examples only; never scientific evidence.

demonstrations.task: Choose which of two anonymous functional materials is better supported for a vaccine-delivery role.
candidate_A: Direct target-cell experiment reports delivery of the intended biomacromolecule and preserved viability.
A second experiment reports target-relevant immune activation.
candidate_B: Several studies report strong generic cellular uptake.
No supplied study measures the target immune endpoint.

ideal.reason: Target-relevant efficacy and immune evidence are more informative for the stated task than generic uptake alone.
must_not_do: Do not compare candidates by paper count alone.

demonstrations.task: Compare two anonymous materials when evidence is mixed.
candidate_A: One study reports target-relevant efficacy, but no safety result is supplied.
candidate_B: One study reports moderate target-relevant efficacy and another reports a substantial toxicity trade-off.

ideal.reason: The supplied evidence does not justify a stable preference without over-interpreting missing safety information or the toxicity trade-off.
